title: Dallas Fed Texas Manufacturing Outlook Survey (Oct 2026 data) — 9:30 a.m. CT / 10:30 ET, the last regional manufacturing survey before an FOMC that meets with no SEP and no forward guidance
source: FRB: dallasfed.org's own Texas Manufacturing Outlook Survey page (dallasfed.org/research/surveys/tmos), re-fetched direct 2026-10-11 with a desktop user-agent (HTTP 200, 42,309 bytes) and quoted VERBATIM from its own markup: the table headed `2026 release dates`, column header `Release (9:30 a.m. CT)`, row `October | Monday, October 26`. Corroborated a second time inside the primary itself — the September report at dallasfed.org/research/surveys/tmos/2026/2609 (HTTP 200, 61,948 bytes) states `Next release: Monday, October 26`. 9:30 a.m. CT = 10:30 ET. Promoted estimate -> confirmed 2026-10-11 by this event's own never-assessed research session on the FRB: slot added by #3117 (a regional Reserve Bank's own published release table) — the same closing path dallas-fed-mfg-2026-09-28 and dallas-fed-mfg-2026-11-30 took; two direct primary reads, no secondary needed. Originally proposed as an estimate on 2026-09-15 by the dallas-fed-mfg-2026-09-28 pulse check
notes: PROPOSED 2026-09-15 by the dallas-fed-mfg-2026-09-28 pulse check. WHY IT IS A GAP AND NOT A DUPLICATE: the calendar tracks September, November and December of this series and skips October — a hole in an otherwise contiguous monthly run, which leaves the next window-arithmetic pass reading a clean 10-26 tape that is not clean. THE ORIGINAL DECLINE IS RECORDED AND ITS GROUNDS HAVE BOTH MOVED: the owning event's 2026-09-01 initial research considered this exact entry and declined it on two grounds — (a) the argument was conditional on a 2026-09-30 appropriations lapse that had not happened, and (b) no fetchable source could date it. Ground (b) is refuted: dallasfed.org serves HTTP 200 and dates it. Ground (a) resolved the OTHER way and is now dead, not pending — H.R. 6500 was signed 2026-09-02 as P.L. 119-103, funding agencies through 2026-12-11 (see government-funding-deadline-2026-09-30), so there is no October lapse, BLS prints normally, and the `one of few hard reads still publishing` argument is spent for this cycle. This proposal therefore does NOT rest on the shutdown branch. WHAT IT RESTS ON INSTEAD: 2026-10-26 is the last regional manufacturing survey before fomc-2026-10-28, a meeting that carries no SEP and no forward guidance (the funding ledger's own finding: `two blindfolds instead of three`), and it is the first Dallas edition whose collection window (≈Oct 13–21 on the release-minus-13 / release-minus-5 rule this lane validated against the primary) sits wholly after the 09-16 decision. Read-it-do-not-trade-it, and the refusal is measured, not assumed: the owning ledger's 20-release study puts this series' release hour at the 52.5th (SPY) / 55.5th (QQQ) percentile of that same hour's own two-year distribution, against a null of 50. `symbols: []`, `low` impact, the date is `estimate`. PROMOTED 2026-10-11 by this event's own initial research: date `confirmed` on the FRB: primary (two direct reads, 09-28 report's `Next release` line and the release table); nothing else about the entry changed — still `low`, `symbols: []`, never a trade.
